basic_profile.bio: SpaceTrader_83 is a 40-year-old financial analyst living in Toronto, Canada. They have a keen interest in space technology, liberal politics, and foreign exchange markets. In their free time, they enjoy hiking and exploring local wildlife. Despite a demanding job, they find time to delve into online RPGs and IT certification courses. Typically, they are active on Reddit during the evenings and weekends. Currently single, they value their independence and the freedom to explore various interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: SpaceTrader_83 has a strong foundation in finance, with a Bachelor's degree in Economics and over a decade of experience in the financial sector. They are self-taught in space technology and actively follow advancements in the field through online resources. Their interest in politics is nurtured by participating in discussions and staying updated on global events.
